source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Errata to the Chronomancer, Geomancer, Orikan the Diviner, Plasmancer, Psychomancer and Technomancer datasheets:

- Each keeps **[Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader)** and also gains the **[Support](vsdata:core-ability/support)** core ability.
- Their **[Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader)** sections lose the sentence allowing the model to attach to one of its listed units even when a **ROYAL WARDEN** or **NOBLE** unit is already attached to it, along with its follow-on rule that, if that Bodyguard unit gets **destroyed**, the attached **[Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader)** units split off with their original **Starting Strengths**.

operations.removedFollowOn: attached Leader units become separate units at original Starting Strengths if the Bodyguard unit is destroyed
